distinguisher: The representation carried a column set and the generated SQL projects a different one; the column-metadata type covers an element for which no column set was declared at all.
note: Distinct from a missing column list: here a column set exists and states something the document does not, which is why it is a divergence rather than an absence.
text: The generated artifact for '{element}' of kind '{kind}' produces a row set that does not correspond to what the document declares: columns, row count or a routing decision. A verification pass recorded an input on which the two differ. {detail}
title: The generated row set does not match what the document declares for the element
